subject: Quality telemetry & rollback thresholds for Acme onboarding
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acmehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: quality monitoring + canary plan for prompt sets

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to move forward with Redwood's quality monitoring for the initial onboarding phase. Attached is a first-pass CSV of the prompt sets our product team uses (AcmePromptSets_v1.csv) and a short requirements doc (Acme_Onboard_REQS.pdf).

High level asks:
- Integrate our baseline prompt sets into your eval harness and run attention/regression checks against the last 3 weeks of production traffic.
- Define an initial canary window and rollback thresholds for toxicity, hallucination rate (as measured vs. our reference responses), and latency regressions.
- Send us a mutual action plan (MAP) with dates and an owner for each step.

Procurement and legal are looped on billing/timing questions (see Procurement). Alex from our DevOps will own CI integration.

Can you confirm next steps and a propose timeline? Ideally a short canary in late March.

Thanks,
Sarah Lim
Head of Product, Acme Health
Attachments: AcmePromptSets_v1.csv (CSV, 12KB), Acme_Onboard_REQS.pdf (PDF, 84KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: quality monitoring + canary plan for prompt sets

Hi Sarah — thanks for the materials, received and skimmed.

Proposed immediate next steps from our side:
1) Intake: Marissa will import your CSV into our eval harness and map to eval types (intent/regression/toxicity/latency).
2) Baseline run: run historical comparisons (3 weeks) and return a signal summary and suggested threshold bands.
3) Canary plan: we propose a 72-hour canary with progressive traffic ramp (5% -> 25% -> 75%) and automatic rollback triggers for:
   - >= 30% relative increase in hallucination rate vs baseline
   - absolute toxicity > 0.6 (model score) on sampled prompts
   - 95th percentile latency increase > 120% over baseline
4) MAP: I will share a mutual action plan doc (MAP_Acme_QMon_v1.xlsx) with owners/dates by EOD Tuesday.

Can you confirm who on your side will sign off the MAP (product or procurement) and whether the CI integration needs an SSH key or service account?

I'll schedule a 30-minute planning call tomorrow.

— Jonas
Product Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: quality monitoring + canary plan for prompt sets

Quick note from the CS implementation perspective — high level checklist I'm going to run:
- Prompt mapping (classification of prompt intent + golden reference assignment) — ETA 2 business days.
- Eval harness integration (runner + ID mapping for traceability) — ETA 4 business days.
- Canary orchestration plan (traffic ramp, observability dashboards, alerting rules) — ETA 3 business days.
- Regression alerting: set two tiers:
   * Warning: 10–20% relative delta, notify CS/Dev (Slack + email)
   * Critical: >20% relative delta or breach of absolute thresholds -> auto-fail canary and trigger rollback policy.

Proposed owners:
- Mapping + golden refs: Marissa (CS) with Acme SMEs (Sarah + Alex)
- Eval runs & gates: Rishi (Applied ML)
- Canary ops & rollout: Lauren (Product Ops)

I'll attach a draft of the MAP and the initial thresholds in the shared drive. Marissa
Attachments referenced: MAP_Acme_QMon_v1.xlsx (drive link sent separately)
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-17T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: quality monitoring + canary plan for prompt sets

Thanks, Marissa — this looks good. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- For golden refs we will provide expected outputs for ~120 sample prompts; expect to send those by EOD tomorrow.
- CI integration: Alex says a service account with a short-lived token is preferred (no SSH). We'll email DevOps checklist separately.
- On thresholds: the hallucination relative increase trigger seems high at 30% for auto-rollback. Can we propose a two-stage auto-fail:
   - Stage A (auto-throttle): >= 20% relative increase -> pause ramp and alert
   - Stage B (auto-rollback): >= 35% relative increase or absolute hallucination > 0.25 on critical prompts

If you can reflect that in the MAP we'll review and sign. Procurement put a tentative go-live window in the week of March 29 but need MAP and final pricing to lock.

— Sarah
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: quality monitoring + canary plan for prompt sets

Appreciate the quick feedback, Sarah. Updated plan summary below and attached MAP (MAP_Acme_QMon_v1.xlsx).
- Golden refs: Acme to deliver 120 expected outputs by 2026-03-18 23:59 PT.
- Canary cadence: 5% -> 25% (48h) -> 75% (24h) -> full if green.
- Auto-throttle (= pause ramp): >= 20% relative hallucination increase OR 95p latency > 110%
- Auto-rollback (fail canary): >= 35% relative hallucination increase OR absolute hallucination > 0.25 on critical prompt set OR sustained toxicity scoring > 0.6 on sampled window.
- Owners and signoffs included in MAP; procurement to confirm billing and go/no-go by 2026-03-22.

Links/attachments in MAP: drive link + HubSpot record. Please review and mark the signoff cell when ready. I'll coordinate a short pre-canary runbook review on 2026-03-24.

Best,
Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acmehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: quality monitoring + canary plan for prompt sets

All set from CS. Quick operational notes before we go into MAP signoff:
- Eval harness will publish a nightly regression summary and push critical alerts to the dedicated Slack channel (#acme-qmon-alerts).
- We'll tag HubSpot with the canary run IDs for traceability.
- Rollback procedure: on auto-rollback we will: 1) immediately cut traffic back to pre-canary baseline; 2) open an incident in PagerDuty; 3) snapshot model + input set and hand off to Applied ML for root cause; 4) re-run evals against golden refs and produce an RCA within 24 hours.

Next actions for Acme: upload golden refs and confirm procurement signoff. We will aim for pre-canary smoke on 2026-03-25 and full canary on 2026-03-29 if procurement approves.

Cheers,
Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
